Summary: Confirms security-sensitive change scope is either approved or explicitly bounded by a documented exception.
PassCriteria: Required security review occurred, open risks are accepted with conditions, and no unresolved high-severity blocker remains hidden.
FailCriteria: Security review is missing, incomplete, or reveals unresolved unacceptable risk.
EscalationRule: Escalate to release approver and accountable governance owner; freeze release progression.
